The shop

A husband, a wife, and a room full of regulars

T J Nails is run by Tom and Tina — husband and wife — with John and Rosa working beside them.

They don't do much talking online. The last thing they posted was this, in their own words, on their own Facebook page: “Hello it your favorite person again. I hope you all enjoyed the good summer this year. So stop complaining about the rain when you are in the shop. Love all of you and thank you for supporting our business.”

That's the whole shop in four sentences. Families come in together — one customer wrote that her mom, her sister and she have come here since they moved to Bonney Lake more than ten years ago, and that there's “no other place that I would wanna get my nails at.”
